# GOTO.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp53.0 against Rp24.0 (expected total return 120.8%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: digital_bank_path_to_profit · method card: per fund record routing for Internet platforms & e-commerce.

- FY2026E net profit attributable of 780 is 33% below the 1,164.5 already reported for the nine months to September [S4 p6], yet the model own Q4 EBITDA is a positive 404 and its Q4 interest charge is only about 130. The t
